name: Ruri
source:
"Real" world's Ruri who inspired [url=/c137077]Kiryuu Hajime[/url] to create all his other characters with the same name.
She's a girl who lost her parents in an accident and got adopted by Hajime's mentor [url=/c18945]Kyou[/url].
